description: Look up which companies DecaData has point-of-sale (till) data for: ~380 US consumer-goods makers like PepsiCo or Kraft Heinz, by name or ticker (free). For company sales research, not shopping: it doesn't find products, prices or deals. Returns ISIN, ticker, name, tier (1 largest, 3 smallest, weekly only) and the first and last day of data.

query.description: Part of a name or ticker, e.g. 'pepsi' or 'KO'. Empty: the largest companies.

name: find_companies
title: Find companies
